name: effect-fence-hold-version-moved
description: HOLD reason `version_moved`. The coordinator records version 1; the caller's decision was derived from version 7. Both comparands are real and non-zero, so leg 2 passes them through and leg 3 answers: the value the decision was derived from is not the value the coordinator holds. This is the plainest stale-decision case and the one an agent recovers from by re-reading -- pinned here so a reason rename would fail the corpus rather than silently downgrade every consumer's branch to 'unrecognised hold'.
